name: dsh-taskboard-kit
description: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) taskboard kit: one local task board per workspace. Agents create/claim/progress tasks with model tools; humans watch and drive the same board in a kanban tab — a single JSON file in the workspace is the only source of truth, no server needed. 给每个 dsh workspace 一块本地任务看板：Agent 用工具认领推进，界面里点「看板」就能协同，数据就是工作区里的一个 JSON 文件。
